description:
The Coaching Scheme for Divyang Students was launched by the Government of India in 2014. 

This scheme aims to provide financial assistance for coaching to students with disabilities. 

The initiative is part of the larger framework of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to enhance the educational and employment opportunities for Divyang students. 

The scheme specifically targets students preparing for competitive examinations. 

These examinations include those for professional courses and government jobs. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is intended to cover the costs of coaching classes. 

The scheme also aims to empower Divyang students by providing them with the necessary skills and knowledge. 

The assistance is provided to students who are enrolled in recognized institutions. 

The maximum financial assistance available under this scheme is ₹50,000 per year. 

This amount can be utilized for various expenses related to coaching. 

Eligible coaching institutions must be recognized by the government. 

The scheme is applicable to students from Class 9 onwards. 

There is no upper age limit specified for applicants. 

However, the students must have a disability certificate issued by a competent authority. 

The disability must be at least 40 percent as defined under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act. 

Students must also belong to economically weaker sections to qualify for the scheme. 

The income limit for eligibility is set at ₹6 lakh per annum. 

This income criterion ensures that the benefits reach those who are truly in need. 

The application process for the Coaching Scheme for Divyang Students is straightforward. 

Interested candidates must fill out the application form available on the official website. 

The application form requires personal details such as name, address, and contact information. 

Candidates must also provide details of their disability and the coaching institution they wish to attend. 

A copy of the disability certificate must be attached to the application. 

Additionally, proof of income must be submitted to verify eligibility. 

The completed application form should be submitted to the District Disability Rehabilitation Centre. 

The application must be submitted within the specified timeframe to ensure consideration. 

Once the application is received, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The disbursement of funds is made directly to the coaching institution. 

This ensures that the financial assistance is utilized for its intended purpose. 

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. 

The ministry has established various nodal agencies to oversee the implementation. 

These agencies are responsible for monitoring the progress of the scheme. 

They also ensure that the funds are disbursed in a timely manner. 

The scheme has seen a significant uptake since its launch. 

In the financial year 2020-2021, over 5,000 applications were received. 

Out of these, approximately 4,200 students were granted financial assistance. 

This reflects a growing awareness and utilization of the scheme among Divyang students. 

The government has also made efforts to promote the scheme through various outreach programs. 

Workshops and seminars have been conducted to educate potential beneficiaries. 

The scheme is part of the broader commitment of the Indian government to inclusivity. 

It aligns with the Sustainable Development Goals set by the United Nations. 

The Coaching Scheme for Divyang Students is a crucial step towards ensuring equal opportunities. 

It aims to bridge the gap in educational access for students with disabilities. 

The government continues to seek feedback from beneficiaries to improve the scheme. 

Regular assessments are conducted to evaluate the impact of the scheme. 

The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment is committed to making necessary adjustments. 

This ensures that the scheme remains relevant and effective. 

The Coaching Scheme for Divyang Students is a vital initiative. 

It not only provides financial assistance but also fosters confidence among students. 

By equipping them with the necessary skills, the scheme aims to enhance their employability. 

The government encourages all eligible students to take advantage of this scheme. 

The application process is designed to be user-friendly and accessible. 

Students are urged to gather all required documents before applying. 

This includes the disability certificate and proof of income. 

Timely submission of applications is crucial for securing funding. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to social justice. 

It reflects a broader vision of an inclusive society where everyone has equal opportunities. 

The Coaching Scheme for Divyang Students has the potential to transform lives. 

By supporting education and skill development, it paves the way for a brighter future. 

Students are encouraged to stay informed about updates related to the scheme. 

The official website provides the latest information and resources. 

In conclusion, the Coaching Scheme for Divyang Students is a comprehensive initiative. 

It aims to empower students with disabilities through financial assistance for coaching. 

The scheme is designed to ensure that these students can compete on an equal footing. 

With a focus on inclusivity and empowerment, it represents a significant step forward. 

The government remains dedicated to enhancing the lives of Divyang individuals. 

This scheme is one of many efforts to create a more equitable society.
